content: Human-labeling session — combat-kite-and-pull:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, this is a combat engagement against a single enemy heavy. You are given 3 medium tanks (Return-Fire orders) on either the north corridor (y=10) or south corridor (y=30) depending on seed. One enemy heavy tank at 70% HP hunts from the mid latitude (y=20) — its cannon hits harder than yours and it out-trades you head-on. Kill the heavy with all 3 tanks alive, within 3600 ticks.
